runs.text:
Screaming Bones - Screaming Bones (Full Album) Screaming Bones opens with 'Here Come the Waves‘, gigantic waves of sound carry a fragile guitar all the way into your ears. 'March of the Morons‘ stands for all the idiots following their arsehole leaders and their lies, shouting 'Hooray!‘ while the world goes to hell. Enjoy the jazzy vibe of 'Neon Lights in the Rain‘ before 'All Beauty is Pain‘ makes your hair stand up. 'Ridin‘ High‘ sees you off in the morning and 'Fuck Off!‘ injects some attitude in your ear before you get to experience the pure craziness of 'Electric Noise‘…love it or hate it, there is no in-between. 'When I Was Young‘ hangs around in long-gone memories, 'A Story About Hopes and Dreams‘ is not really a song, it’s a story about lost chances and unfulfilled promises. The album sees you off with an alternative, a bit noisier take on 'Neon Lights in the Rain‘.

1.  Here Come The Waves 
2.  March Of The Morons 
3.  Neon Lights In The Rain 
4.  All Beauty Is Pain 
5.  Ridin' High 
6.  Fuck Off! 
7.  Electric Noise 
8.  When I Was Young 
9.  A Story About Hopes And Dreams 
10. Neon Lights In The Rain - Alternate Version

Stoned Meadow of Doom is the premier heavy rock promotion channel on the web. For over 10 years, SMOD has been the biggest and best platform for all things Stoned and Doomed! Support SMOD if you appreciate this service.  SMOD is a full time job for me.  https://www.patreon.com/MeadowOfDoom

You can also donate via Paypal:   paypal.me/StonedMeadowOfDoom
